title: Do Not Waste Your Money
text: Do Not Waste Your Money. Beware the pots slide on the stove. They are dangerous, especially on a gas stove with grates. Also I purchased them specifically because they were dishwasher safe and non stick. They CANNOT take the dishwasher. The finish on the handles is peeling off and the coating around rim is also peeling. I used one pan to fry a few hash browns and when I dumped out the oil the coating on the bottom was peeling. These pans are junk!!!!
